scope: Add current OpenCADStudio application, codec-lineage, native-output acceptance, and cross-version DWG graph evidence to the existing DWG/DXF parity plan.

method.kind: Primary project documentation/source, issue reports and maintainer resolutions, plus local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceBoundary: OpenCADStudio is a current downstream application candidate, but its current Cargo manifest uses opencadcodec, whose repository identifies it as a fork of ACadRust; do not count those as independent parser lineages. OpenCADStudio issue reports and maintainer resolutions are peer-specific, release/source/operation scoped, and not local reproductions. The app's audit/self-readback is distinct from reference-CAD AUDIT. No attached drawing was downloaded, no peer was executed, and no support claim was promoted.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio current application route and ACadRust codec lineage
observed: OpenCADStudio advertises native DWG/DXF read/write from R14 through R2018 and a 2D/3D CAD consumer workflow.
Its current Cargo manifest identifies package version 2026.41.0 and pins opencadcodec, opencadkernel, and opencadgraph by Git revisions.

The opencadcodec repository identifies itself as forked from hakanaktt/acadrust; therefore OpenCADStudio and ACadRust are correlated parser evidence, even though OpenCADStudio is a separate application consumer.
doesNotEstablish: per-family or per-direction fidelity from the advertised version range
that current main behavior matches a released binary
an independent parser vote from ACadRust
evidence.planUse: Admit OpenCADStudio as an optional application/consumer route at a composed checkpoint. Record exact app, codec and kernel revisions, build/platform, operation, file versions and diagnostics. Do not count it as an independent parser lineage beside ACadRust.

evidence.topic: Application audit, verified save and native reference acceptance
observed: The documented audit reports manifests, layers, blocks, finite bounds, duplicate handles, dangling DXF handle references, source hash and dropped-on-save data.
save_verified writes an explicit target version, reopens the output, checks its actual version and compares a semantic entity manifest.
A separate Windows reference-acceptance script opens versioned DWGs read-only and runs native AUDIT without repairs.
doesNotEstablish: independence of app self-audit or self-readback from the app's writer/parser
that the documented harness has been run against libdxfrw output
3D topology or geometry semantics from a successful file audit
evidence.planUse: At one planned composed checkpoint, audit the exact locally generated libdxfrw artifacts with a pinned app build, then run reference-CAD read-only AUDIT only when the native console is available. Keep app parse, native audit, graph closure and 3D semantic results separate.

observed: The issue reported an AC1021 source rewritten as AC1032, with recovery failures spanning Layout/EvalGraph framing, dynamic-block relations, MLeader records, XDATA handle references, and XREF-dependent layer/path state.

The maintainer reported a fix to the R2013+ entity header and Layout field order/widths, same-version AcDs link retention, and validation against the supplied source pair using AutoCAD recovery/audit.
The maintainer reported 345 MLeader and 8 Layout records matching, removal of 344 invalid MLeader version records, and a byte-identical 613-segment AcDs section for the same-version save.
doesNotEstablish: an independently reproduced result or a current OpenCADStudio defect
evidence.planUse: Use the incident as a generated test-design lead for the existing graph-preservation and writer gates. Verify actual output AC code, separate same-version AcDs replay from conversion, and retain native audit logs.

observed: The issue was closed after the maintainer reported that the supplied HATCH/polyline case saved as R2018 opened without recovery in a strict third-party reader and produced no LibreDWG errors.
doesNotEstablish: that libdxfrw has the same defect
associative boundary fidelity, rendered parity or solid semantics
local reproduction; the supplied drawing was not downloaded
evidence.planUse: Retain locally generated HATCH boundary/owner controls in the composed DWG output gate; do not add the issue attachment as a repository fixture.

evidence.topic: Application state versus file-stored viewport data
observed: An unresolved OpenCADStudio report distinguishes the active paper editing viewport/effective UCS after reopen from the stored viewport identities and values.
doesNotEstablish: whether the report is an application-state defect, codec defect or format limitation
a missing libdxfrw field or an authoritative DWG layout rule
evidence.planUse: Keep application-current-context qualification distinct from file Layout/VIEWPORT/UCS preservation. Verify any format interpretation against the repository's authoritative ODA specification before changing byte logic.

observed: A user reported 3D object interoperability problems; the maintainer later reported one pyramid/cylinder Boolean example saved as R2018 and accepted by a strict third-party reader.
doesNotEstablish: exact ACIS/ASM body identity, B-rep topology, units or geometric metrics
general DWG/DXF 3D support from one sample or successful open
evidence.planUse: Preserve the existing evidence ladder: file acceptance, exact wrapper/carrier closure, projection, B-rep metrics and named native application results remain separate.

observed: FreeCAD documents C++ and legacy Python DXF import/export routes with different feature sets and options affecting units/scaling, output geometry, hatches, colors, splines and polyface export.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of every FreeCAD release/platform
DWG parser or ACIS support from a DXF importer selection
evidence.planUse: For a FreeCAD consumer qualification, bind the exact release, converter, importer/exporter mode, operation, preferences and resulting document geometry.

nextActions: Continue fast per-slice local build/test/compatibility checks without requiring optional peers or native applications.
At the existing composed output checkpoint, reuse generated scratch controls and verify requested versus actual file version.
Treat OpenCADStudio as a correlated ACadRust-family application result; capture exact app/codec/kernel revisions and full loss/diagnostic manifest.
Keep same-version AcDs retention separate from cross-version conversion and exact carrier identity separate from 3D geometry semantics.
If a native reference CAD console is available, run read-only AUDIT without repair on the exact output and preserve the per-version raw logs; otherwise report NOT_RUN.
Keep all six J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
